Name: (CP) No more perfection for golden egg
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img][/center][center]I never understood why ConcernedApe added the Golden Chickens as something unlockable after perfection, I mean, I unlocked everything, I'm swimming in gold coins, I live on a perfect farm and I have 2 beautiful children, and what you give me for all that IS A GOLDEN EGG?

Anyway, The lady who owns the traveling cart sells you the egg for 100,000 gold coins (Same price as Marnie if you reach perfection) this egg has a 20% chance of appearing in her store (daily luck affects the probability)
[b]
[color=#e06666][size=5]Both the egg price and spawn rate can be configured with the Generic mod config menu.[/size][/color][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SWVYd8J.png[/img]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32607][color=#93c47d]Living Portraits[/color][/url] A mod that adds backgrounds to portraits based on your location!﻿﻿﻿[/center][center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17272][color=#d5a6bd]Seasonal Vanilla UI[/color][/url] A mod that decorates the characters' UI according to the season and festival!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16760][color=#ffe599]Seasonal Leaf Cursor[/color][/url] A leaf-shaped cursor that changes with the season!﻿﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20837][color=#38761d]Flowery and not blue grass[/color][/url] Add flowers to the grass seasonally and turn blue grass into dark green grass.
